title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Regarding umrah 2466 views Q. asalamualaykum mufti sahib I Belong to U.P.(India), working in Saudi Arabia & planning to perform HAJJ. When my father was sick ,two years ago, I lend some money for treating him and at the time of coming Saudi Arabia I again lend some money from another person and did?t pay so far.Both the person never demand their money.My question is if I perform Hajj after granting their permission with this promise that I will pay the money after perform Hajj and they agree ,it will be a valid Hajj accordance with the islamic principles or requirements or not. Jazakallahukhaira. 1720 views Q. Hajje-badal 4485 views Q. Qurbani in Hajj( Tamatuu ) 6965 views Q. Should Hajj from Madinah be Ifrad? 3817 views Q. My question is related to any kind of bank loan and haj. Is it true that as long as I have any kind of loan against me I can not go for the Haj. 2153 views Q. One of my friends tells me that doing an umrah by wearing ahram from "masjid-e-Aisha" is permissible only for women folk and not for men. His explanation was that Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh) asked aisha(radiallahu anha) to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha" as she was sick during the time of Hajj, and her brother was not asked to do the same when he accompanied her. If this was permissible for men then Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh)would have also asked him to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha". My friend also tells me that according to Imam Abu Hanifa Rahmatulla alayh, such umrah is permissible for men but is makruh. Please quote to the exact hadith in discussion and explanation as to how and why it is permissible for men and also comment on the views of my friend. Jazakallahukhaira. 4361 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1926 views Q. If we stay in MAKKAH doing more UMRAH is best or more TAWAF is best? 5569 views Q. Can one send his father on a nafli hajj before himself doing an obligatory hajj? 1918 views Q. visiting makkah without ihram(no intension of umrah) 22619 views Q. Tawaf 2767 views Q. hajj and umra 3247 views Q. I went from USA to Jeddah on April 2010. I stayed with my relatives in Jeddah for 3-4 days, then I made intention of Umrah, put ihram in Jeddah, and went to Makkah to complete my umrah? Was this right? 2056 views Q. Haj 2583 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 42348 Country: India Title: Entered Haram without Ihraam for Hajj Question: My friend is living in Saudi Arabia 1000 km away from Makkah, this year his relative come here to perform hajj from India. My friend entered Makkah without Ihram with intention to help his relatives and if possible he will also perform hajj. He entered Makkah on 8th Oct 2012. Please guide how he can perform acceptable hajj? Answer ID: 42348 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1726/1085/L=1433) If he performs hajj by going Makkah and offers the arkan and wajib practices of hajj then it is hoped that Almighty Allah shall accept his hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
